articles.summary: CRA Competition supported Microsoft’s historic $69 billion acquisition of Activision Blizzard, providing expertise across all jurisdictions—including the FTC challenge, the European Commission and CMA review processes, and clearance decisions by dozens of other countries worldwide. articles.title: CRA Competition team advises on Microsoft’s acquisition of Activision Blizzard across jurisdictions worldwide
